## Details

<a id="room_state_a"></a>
### [`room_state_a`](../../../../src/room/room_dispatch.asm#L7) `$4E97`

*variable*

Room scratch variables room_state_a..e: cleared at each room entry (room_init_clear_vars) before the room init handler runs. Each room's init and frame handlers use them as their own timers, counters and step flags.

- **Read by:** [`room00_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room00_frame), [`room01_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room01_frame), [`room02_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room02_frame), [`room03_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room03_frame), [`room04_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room04_frame), [`room06_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room06_frame), [`room07_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room07_frame), [`room08_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room08_frame), [`room09_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room09_frame), [`room10_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room10_frame), [`room11_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room11_frame), [`room18_frame`](wizard_room.md#room18_frame) and 5 more

<a id="room_init_handlers"></a>
### [`room_init_handlers`](../../../../src/room/room_dispatch.asm#L19) `$4E9C-$4EC3`

*data*

Room init handlers: 20 words, target-1, index = room. room_init_dispatch jumps to the handler of the current room with PHA/PHA/RTS after the room is drawn.

- **Read by:** [`setup_room_lanterns_and_init`](lantern_pickup.md#setup_room_lanterns_and_init)

<a id="room_frame_handlers"></a>
### [`room_frame_handlers`](../../../../src/room/room_dispatch.asm#L28) `$4EC4-$4EEB`

*data*

Room frame handlers: 20 words, target-1, index = room. run_room_frame_handler jumps to the handler of the current room with PHA/PHA/RTS on every main loop pass (lantern animations, opening passages, hazards, the wizard and the fireballs, the congratulations room).

- **Read by:** [`run_room_frame_handler`](passage_open.md#run_room_frame_handler)
